phrase: There is orange powder under the coffee leaves on the upper slope.
note: clear rust sign: powder on the underside

phrase: The coffee leaves have yellow spots on top, and when I turn them over there is orange dust.
note: rust described from both leaf sides

phrase: Some coffee leaves have dots on them.
note: too vague: rust / brown eye spot / leaf miner / Phoma all fit; should return a tell-apart question

phrase: The coffee leaves are turning yellow.
note: too vague: nitrogen / rust / root problems all fit

phrase: My coffee is not doing well this year.
note: no symptom at all

phrase: Something is wrong with the coffee berries.
note: no detail

phrase: The green coffee berries are turning black and sinking in, and many are dropping.
note: urgent; not_sure is acceptable but another urgent name is not

phrase: Black sunken spots on the young green berries since the rains started.
note: urgent; classic CBD timing

phrase: There is a tiny hole at the tip of many coffee berries, and small black beetles inside.
note: pinhead hole at the berry tip

phrase: When I bend the brown patches on the coffee leaves, the top skin lifts and there are little white worms inside.
note: blister mine with caterpillars

phrase: The coffee leaves have round brown spots with a grey centre, like an eye.
note: eye-shaped spot with grey centre

phrase: The new coffee seedlings in the nursery have spots and are losing leaves.
note: nursery is the typical setting; spots alone are weak evidence

phrase: One coffee tree suddenly went yellow and wilted, and the wood under the bark near the ground is blue-black.
note: urgent; blue-black wood is the tell-tale sign

phrase: My coffee trees are drooping in the afternoon. It has not rained for three weeks.
note: many trees at once during a dry spell

phrase: The bottom of the coffee stem is pinched thin with a dead brown patch of bark, and the tree is wilting.
note: urgent; constricted stem base

phrase: The coffee trees in the field we cleared from forest are slowly dying, there is white fungus on the roots, and the dead one fell over when I pushed it.
note: urgent; topples easily (wilt-killed trees stay rooted)

phrase: The young coffee leaves near the top have brown spots with a wide yellow ring, and the shoot tips are dying. It is cold and windy here.
note: urgent; yellow halo plus cold wind

phrase: Young coffee leaves at the shoot tips have black dead patches and are curled. It has been cold and rainy.
note: dead tissue on young tip leaves

phrase: All my coffee trees look pale yellow, the whole leaf, and there are no spots or powder.
note: even pale yellow with no spots

phrase: On the old coffee leaves the veins stay green but the leaf between them is yellow.
note: yellow between green veins on old leaves

phrase: The edges of the old coffee leaves look burnt and dead, but the strip along the middle vein is still green.
note: burnt margins with green midrib

phrase: After the heavy rain last night, water is standing under the coffee in the low part, and those trees are yellowing.
note: standing water after 40 mm-type rain

phrase: Pale bleached patches appeared on the coffee leaves right after we pruned and cut down the shade trees.
note: sudden sun exposure

phrase: The tips of the coffee branches are dying after the big harvest. The tree carried a huge crop.
note: dieback after a heavy crop

phrase: The hail yesterday tore the coffee leaves and broke some branches.
note: clear weather cause

phrase: There are shield-shaped brown bugs with orange and white marks hiding in the coffee berry clusters.
note: insect described directly

phrase: There are round holes as wide as a pencil in the bottom of the coffee trunk, with sawdust on the ground.
note: urgent; holes plus sawdust at the stem base

phrase: White cotton-like insects between the coffee berries, and lots of ants on the branches.
note: white waxy insects tended by ants

phrase: Flat green insects sit in rows along the veins under the coffee leaves, and the leaves are black and sticky.
note: sooty mould is the symptom; green scale is the cause

phrase: When I dug around a wilting coffee tree there were white insects on the roots.
note: insects on roots

phrase: The coffee leaves have silvery grey patches with tiny black dots, and it has been very dry.
note: silvering in drought

phrase: The young coffee seedlings are small and yellow, and there are little knots on the roots.
note: root galls

phrase: Small branches on my robusta are drying and turning black, and I see a tiny hole under the branch.
note: hole on the underside of a drying twig is the tell-tale

phrase: One branch of my coffee dried up and there is a small round hole on the lower side of the twig.
note: hole plus drying twig

phrase: The leaves on some branches of my robusta are wilting and the branches are dying, but I have not looked closely.
note: twig borer vs coffee wilt: needs the tell-apart question (hole under the twig? blue-black wood?)

phrase: Some branches on my robusta have started wilting and drying one after another, and the berries on them are drying too.
note: twig borer vs coffee wilt vs overbearing dieback; the hole question decides

phrase: The whole coffee field is pale yellow and the leaves are small, and I have not put manure for many years.
note: evenly pale field plus no manure; nitrogen deficiency is a look-alike

phrase: My coffee gives less and less every year and the soil is tired, I never add manure or fertiliser.
note: declining yield with no feeding

phrase: My coffee trees are very old and tall with many thin branches, and they give only a few berries.
note: old overgrown trees

phrase: The stems are crowded and too tall to pick, and I have never pruned or cut back the old ones.
note: never pruned or stumped

phrase: Grass has grown over my coffee and the young trees are small and not growing.
note: weeds smothering young coffee

phrase: I left the shamba without weeding for the whole season and now the coffee gives very little.
note: weeds plus low yield; soil fertility is a look-alike

phrase: The buyer paid me less because my coffee had green beans mixed in and some smelled mouldy.
note: quality and price loss from picking and drying

phrase: I dried my coffee on the bare ground and the rain wet it again, and now it smells musty.
note: bare-ground drying and rewetting

phrase: I stripped all the cherries off the branch at once, green and red together.
note: strip picking
